name: Discovery and Decision Suite
promise: Turn a hard question and typed evidence into a resumable decision record.
completion_criteria: InvestigationRecord preserves question, premises, typed evidence, stages, budgets, decisions, and recovery.
Selected SIF stages run behind Forge modes with output and failure parity.
Cross-source discovery cites immutable SourceRecords and records novelty evaluation.
Shadow Mirror remains private, non-clinical, energy-gated, and outside generalized claims.

waves.objective: Create a SIF-to-Forge stage and artifact parity matrix.
waves.acceptance: Each candidate stage has typed inputs, outputs, budget, failure, resume, and accept or reject evidence.
waves.runtime_followup: Execute both runtimes on one question and diff their stage outputs, rather than mapping retained artifacts.

waves.objective: Project one retained SIF red-team artifact into a bounded suite-local Forge record.
waves.acceptance: The content-addressed donor artifact is retained in a contract-valid InvestigationRecord with a source-derived budget, while runtime, consent, resume, and SQLite gates are explicitly recorded as unexecuted.
waves.runtime_followup: Run the red-team stage live inside Forge with consent and resume gates, not a carried artifact.

waves.objective: Anchor two Insight Excavator documents as cited SourceRecords without claiming semantic discovery.
waves.acceptance: Immutable SourceRecords and byte anchors validate, lexical overlap is measured, and semantic discovery, novelty, and uncertainty remain explicitly unclaimed.
waves.runtime_followup: Run the Excavator discovery path to produce the real claims, novelty, and uncertainty measures.

waves.objective: Project a retained SIF analogy artifact through a bounded suite-local Forge record.
waves.acceptance: The content-addressed artifact is retained in a contract-valid deep-mode InvestigationRecord with a source-derived budget, while both donor runtimes remain unexecuted.
waves.runtime_followup: Run analogy synthesis live in deep mode with real call-budget accounting.

waves.objective: Project one Insight Excavator citation into a suite-local Forge record and prepare a retirement proposal.
waves.acceptance: SourceRecord provenance survives the projection while runtime ingestion, owner approval, and standalone-runtime retirement remain explicitly false.
waves.runtime_followup: Forge ingests Excavator sources directly and the owner approves the disposition; only then is the standalone runtime retired.
